SELECT /* LGVPAYP0005.retrieveCodeList */ a.common_code , b.common_code_name FROM lgcom_common_code_c a , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c b WHERE a.code_type_code = #{codeTypeCode} AND b.code_type_code = a.code_type_code AND b.common_code = a.common_code AND b.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}
AND a.common_code LIKE #{commonCode}||'%'
AND b.common_code_name LIKE #{commonCodeName}||'%'
ORDER BY a.sort_order_no
